'''Project Cicerone''' was a joint project of the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]] and [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]]. It was a branch of a larger project that had been running in various forms for decades by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], dealing with [[SLV-16|SLV serum]], genetic loyalty programming, and [[Castellan restraints]]. [[Cipher Nine]] later become a victim of Castellan mind control.
